verdict.rationale: Extend documents its own Parse API, which returns chunks and metadata. Its parsing docs cover agentic OCR, tables, figures and equations, and marketing claims it parses the 'hardest documents with unmatched accuracy.' No evidence addresses the story's specific complex-layout requirements, so depth on those is unproven. missing for 10: documented multi-column reading-order handling, header/footer detection or removal, footnote handling, independent or hands-on corroboration of parse accuracy on complex PDFs

support.subject: As a developer, the API parses complex real-world PDFs — multi-column layouts, headers, footers, footnotes — into clean, correctly ordered content

citations.quote: Parse, extract, and split your hardest documents with unmatched accuracy.
Figures, charts, diagrams, and equations · Agentic OCR and tables
Parse runs now include a **`metadata`** object on `output`, alongside `chunks`
